state:
Goal `core-time-and-1-more`: `Core\Time::at` has all its feature proofs — `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench with a recorded figure, a Rust test and a `.nvst` case — and `Core\Time` now has its class card (`TIME_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`, struck from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`).
The attack found that `at` threw jiff's own overflow sentence for a time past the timestamp range (`9999-12-31` in UTC, though the card said any year up to 9999 worked). It now throws `Core\Time::at(): the time is outside -9999-01-02T01:59:59Z..=9999-12-30T22:00:00Z`, and the card names that range.
`fromEpoch` and `fromIso` are untaken, and live in the same file.

next.title: the `Core\Time` entry points
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` (the `TIME` row, its cards and `mod tests`), plus each member's own proof directories.

items.text: **`Core\Time::fromEpoch`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2137`, card `TIME_FROM_EPOCH_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2259`. The attack should push `seconds` to both ends of the range the card calls "about ±9999 years": check that the refusal is a plain sentence and does not quote jiff, the way `at`'s did. `built_at` in `mod tests` is the shape for a Rust test that calls a member directly.

**`Core\Time::fromIso`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2153`, card `TIME_FROM_ISO_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2285`. Its `ParseError` is thrown with a message. From Rust, assert `is_err()` if `take_pending` gives `""` (playbook: `thrown_with_issues`).

backlog: `Core\Time::at`'s refusal for a date that does not exist still quotes jiff's wording (`parameter 'day' for `2023-02` is invalid, must be in range `1..=28``), and `docs/examples/core/Time/at/02-a-date-that-does-not-exist.out` pins it. It is readable, but it is not the member's own sentence — owner: goal `plain-comments` if it sweeps messages, otherwise `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`'s module doc.
`Core\Time\Date`, `DateTime`, `Duration`, `Instant`, `TimeOfDay` and `Zone` still owe class cards (`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`) — goal `core-class-cards`.
